title: Governed workbench design lab
purpose: Explore shared review and prose workbench layouts before choosing a production UI implementation.
questions: Can review and prose share context and evidence without losing task-specific semantics?
Can the same subject move from inline assistance to a full workspace without losing selection?
Are blocks, uncertainty, exact consent and safe recovery understandable with minimal human effort?

review.promoteWhen: A named consumer task and attended evidence justify a separately scoped owning-layer implementation.
review.retireWhen: The design question is answered, a successor replaces it, or no owner renews the review.
